citations.quote: the change in price between periods can be thought of as the return to a speculator for providing liquidity
one important function of liquidity suppliers is to serve as counterparty when the order flow is unbalanced.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: In the Grossman-Miller model liquidity is endogenous: with no private information the price move between periods is driven solely by liquidity shocks, so it equals the return risk-averse speculators earn for absorbing temporary order imbalances and supplying immediacy.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: The Nature of Liquidity and the Return to Liquidity Provision
